entity: OLMoTrace (playground.allenai.org), the system of the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2), with the University of Washington, UC Berkeley and Stanford (Liu, Blanton, Elazar, Min and others, arXiv:2504.07096, 9 April 2025, v2 8 July 2025; ACL 2025 System Demonstrations, 2025.acl-demo.18) that finds and shows verbatim matches between spans of a language model's output and documents in the model's full training data, in real time, over an extended infini-gram index; formalized in the provenance meta-aggregator record of 2026-10-29 (https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/olmotrace/)
row_type: C (a public entity on which the archive bears: a tracing tool; an entity of the provenance meta-aggregator)

classes.term: tracing language-model outputs back to training data
classes.basis: field: B2 (arXiv:2504.07096, Abstract: 'the first system that traces the outputs of language models back to their full, multi-trillion-token training data in real time'); B7 (the paper v2, §1: 'Tracing the outputs of language models (LMs) back to their training data is an important problem'; §6 'Tracing LM generation into training data', influence functions named as the classical approach); B6 (Ken Yeung: 'tracing responses back to their original training data'). The census's own kind ('tracing tool') and lineage ('training data') for the entity (PE record, census.json rows[slug == 'olmotrace'].kind, .lineage).

archive: the provenance census places the entity in the lineage 'training data' with capability 'records' and provenance_object 'a span of a language model's output and the training documents that contain it verbatim' (census.json rows[slug == 'olmotrace'].lineage, .capability, .provenance_object); field: B6 ('it primarily tags where a model's data came from'), B7 §1 (tracing outputs to training data).

classes_note: Two classes, each the census's own kind or lineage for the entity, stated by field sources at the loci given: (1) tracing tools from model output to training data (census kind 'tracing tool', lineage 'training data'; B2 Abstract, B7 §1 and §6, B6); (2) training-data provenance (census lineage 'training data', capability 'records', provenance_object; B6, B7 §1). The aliases are the entity's name in both spellings the field uses (OLMoTrace, OlmoTrace on the X card; OLMOTRACE in the ACL abstract), its arXiv number and its ACL Anthology identifier. 'infini-gram' is not an alias: it is the index the entity extends, a separate entity the census lists as unchecked ('infini-gram as a separate record'); 'Ai2 Playground' is the surface the entity runs on. Admission by reading (§3.4): D where a deposit names the entity and says something of it; O-class where a sentence applies an archive category (the Provenance Erasure Rate, parametric claims, citation against matching, the composition layer against the training layer) to tracing outputs to training data or to training-data provenance as a class; a bare list of tools, a citation-list entry or a reference line is not a claim.
